client/src/lib/preload-error-handler.ts.name: Failed update recovery
client/src/lib/preload-error-handler.ts.description: Reloads the page when a freshly deployed version fails to load, while guarding against an endless reload loop.

client/src/lib/queryClient.ts.name: Screen data refresh
client/src/lib/queryClient.ts.description: Decides when screens reload their data, pausing while the tab is hidden and never retrying a change that might run twice.

client/src/lib/resolve-editor-conflict.t.name: Conflict save guard
client/src/lib/resolve-editor-conflict.t.description: Saves a resolved conflict into the file that was actually reviewed, even if another tab has moved on.

client/src/lib/role-boundaries.ts.name: Role placement wording
client/src/lib/role-boundaries.ts.description: Names where a role applies in plain words, such as All Customer Organizations or Global.

client/src/lib/route-reveal-key.ts.name: Screen transition key
client/src/lib/route-reveal-key.ts.description: Keeps the page transition still when moving between screens that belong together, like settings tabs.

client/src/lib/run-usage.ts.name: Run usage summary
client/src/lib/run-usage.ts.description: Summarises what a run cost, how much context it used and how much of that came from the provider's cache.

client/src/lib/solution-back-nav.ts.name: Solution return link
client/src/lib/solution-back-nav.ts.description: Remembers that a page was opened from a Solution so the back link returns there.

client/src/lib/terminology.ts.name: Custom wording
client/src/lib/terminology.ts.description: Lets an organization rename product terms, such as calling an agent an assistant, across every screen.

client/src/lib/useDocumentChrome.ts.name: Browser tab title
client/src/lib/useDocumentChrome.ts.description: Sets the browser tab's title and icon to match the item currently open.

client/src/lib/utils.ts.name: Shared formatting
client/src/lib/utils.ts.description: Formats dates, times, file sizes, numbers, money and durations the same way across the whole app.

client/src/lib/uuid.ts.name: Unique reference codes
client/src/lib/uuid.ts.description: Creates unique reference codes for tracking actions, even on less secure private networks.

client/src/lib/validation.ts.name: Workflow check
client/src/lib/validation.ts.description: Checks a workflow file quietly in the background and updates the run panel with any problems found.

client/src/lib/version.ts.name: App version
client/src/lib/version.ts.description: Records which version of the screens is currently running.
